title: Did you mean…?
hints: Let `d(i, j)` be the distance between the first `i` characters of `a` and the first `j` of `b`. Base cases: `d(0, j) = j` and `d(i, 0) = i`.
Look at the last characters. `d(i, j)` is the smallest of: `d(i-1, j) + 1` (delete), `d(i, j-1) + 1` (insert), and `d(i-1, j-1) + (0 if a[i-1] == b[j-1] else 1)` (substitute or keep).

prev = list(range(len(b) + 1))
for i, ca in enumerate(a, 1):
    cur = [i]
    for j, cb in enumerate(b, 1):
        cur.append(min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + (ca != cb)))
    prev = cur
return prev[-1]
